purpose: Small product-value study; not a publication-grade agent benchmark.

sample.selection: Five manually selected, practically distinct Kotlin engineering concerns.

textSearchBaseline.commandClass: rg -n with the same three terms per concern
textSearchBaseline.interpretation: Text search provides lexical locations. It does not itself provide compilation authority, compiler-resolved declaration identity, exact-source binding or an evidence digest.

freshAttempt.message: CAS catalog snapshot exceeds its bounded size
freshAttempt.interpretation: Operational accumulated-state blocker; the attempt produced no facts and is excluded from the positive sample.

claim: In this five-concern Kotlin sample, Codeclew's evidence path is backed by exact source fragments and 16 passing focused checks; a preserved released navigation receipt demonstrates one bounded response carrying exact source, compiler identity and evidence digests.
claimBoundary: This is a sample-scoped descriptive claim, not an estimate of population-wide agent success or token reduction.
